correctness.rationale: For a finite sigma-field the null sigma-ideal is principal. Modal closure removes all arrows from surviving atoms to null atoms. The marked-space countable-intersection axiom rules out two distinct surviving successors by applying it to two disjoint target atoms and then the whole space. The quotient-by-null-atoms map is an explicit Boolean and modal isomorphism to inverse image under the resulting partial function. The converse and the binary-meet characterization are proved directly. Exhaustive checks on up to three atoms agree.
